_comment: Canonical trust anchors for the Kanonik Auditor Export verifier. The verifier verifies the chain-root/checkpoint SIGNATURE against these public keys, selected by matching signature, NEVER against the key the bundle ships. Entries are distinguished by the public key (sha256_spki_der), not the id. env=production -> attested (PASS); env=dev -> verified but DEGRADED (not production-attested); a signature matching no entry FAILs. Public keys only. Schema v2: every key has a status (active, retired, revoked; a missing status is active; a status this verifier does not know is read as revoked). A revoked key fails every signature it made; a retired key still verifies what it signed while active. The copy published at the well-known address is a v2 file signed by a pinned production key (continuity: signed_by, signed_at, signature over the canonical JSON of the whole file without continuity.signature); the verifier takes an online file only on a valid continuity signature, otherwise it takes nothing from it (a v1 or unsigned file adds nothing; revoked keys are listed under revoked_keys, never in keys; a file signed before min_key_file_signed_at is refused). This shipped file is pinned by distribution (diff it against kanonik-verify) and carries no continuity block. Updated on rotation and published at https://kanonik.ai/.well-known/kanonik-chain-root-keys.json. seal_required_from (optional RFC 3339 instant): a package whose chain root verifies under this key and was signed at or after the instant must carry a v3 root and a package seal (ADR-0052 Amendment 17). Set for the production key from 2026-11-01 (after the v0.1.72 roll-out; a v0.1.71 export must never read Failed, #3396), for the integration key from 2026-10-22 (the first day every int pod signs v3 roots, Q-436), and for the sample key from the start of the year, so no older sample root can stand in for a current one. class=sample always DEGRADED: synthetic data, never customer attestation, even if env is production.

keys.label: Kanonik public sample key - synthetic data only
